## Anthropic / Claude Code

**[1]** "Pricing." *Anthropic*, n.d.
<https://claude.com/pricing>
**Tier:** 2
Pro $20/mo ($17/mo annual, billed $200 up front), Max 5x from $100/mo, Max 20x from $200/mo, Team Standard $20/$25 per seat, Team Premium $100/$125 per seat. Claude Code is included on all paid tiers including Pro. Models listed: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku.

**[2]** "Claude Code overview." *Claude Code Docs*, n.d.
<https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview>
**Tier:** 2
Surfaces: Terminal CLI (curl/PowerShell/CMD/Homebrew/WinGet/apt/dnf/apk), VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin (beta), Desktop app (macOS, Windows x64, Windows ARM64), Web (claude.ai/code), iOS app. Third-party providers supported in Terminal CLI and VS Code (Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, Google Vertex AI). Auto memory, hooks, MCP, sub-agents, Routines (cloud-scheduled), Desktop scheduled tasks, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Slack, Chrome.

**[3]** "Updates to our Consumer Terms." *Anthropic*, August 28, 2025.
<https://www.anthropic.com/news/updates-to-our-consumer-terms>
**Tier:** 2
Effective Aug 28 2025 (rolling out), with Oct 8 2025 selection deadline. Applies to Free, Pro, Max plans (including when those plans use Claude Code). Excludes Claude for Work, Government, Education, and API via Bedrock/Vertex AI. Users choose to allow training data use; if enabled, retention extends to 5 years (de-identified); if declined, 30-day retention.

**[4]** "How long do you store my data?" *Anthropic Privacy Center*, n.d.
<https://privacy.claude.com/en/articles/10023548-how-long-do-you-store-my-data>
**Tier:** 2
Deleted chats removed within 30 days. If model improvement enabled, chats and coding sessions retained up to 5 years de-identified. If disabled, no future training use. Trust & safety violations: inputs/outputs 2 years, classification scores 7 years. Feedback retained 5 years. Incognito chats excluded from training regardless of setting.

**[5]** Willison, Simon. "The Claude Code confusion." *simonwillison.net*, April 22, 2026.
<https://simonwillison.net/2026/apr/22/claude-code-confusion/>
**Tier:** 3
Anthropic silently moved Claude Code from $20 Pro plan to Max-only on April 22 2026 (a "~2% test" per employee tweet), then reverted within hours. No formal announcement. Willison: "A tweet from an employee is not the way to make an announcement like this." Notes OpenAI's Codex remains on free + $20 plans as a safer alternative for educators.

**[6]** "Claude Code Skills, MCP, and Plugins: Comparison Guide." *MorphLLM*, n.d.
<https://www.morphllm.com/claude-code-skills-mcp-plugins>
**Tier:** 3
Skills cost ~30-50 tokens until invoked. MCP servers can consume significant context: a typical 5-server setup with 58 tools uses ~55,000 tokens before any conversation starts. Anthropic's Tool Search reduces this overhead by ~85%. Plugins bundle skills + MCP + hooks + commands + subagents.

Pricing: standard $0.50/M input + $2.50/M output; fast $1.50/M + $7.50/M. Composer 1.5 scored 44.2 on CursorBench; Composer 1 was 38.0. "Fast" is now the default.

**[30]** Quach, Katyanna. "IBM's AI Bob could be manipulated to download and execute malware." *The Register*, January 7, 2026.
<https://www.theregister.com/2026/01/07/ibm_bob_vulnerability/>
**Tier:** 2
PromptArmor research disclosed three flaws in IBM Bob (then in tech preview): (1) process substitution bypass — Bob blocks `$(command)` but not process substitution; (2) command chaining via `>` redirection allowing malicious instructions to follow approved echo commands; (3) markdown image rendering with permissive CSP enables zero-click data exfiltration via pre-fetched JSON schemas. Attack scenario: malicious README.md in a code repo. IBM said it had "no record" of direct notification, emphasized tech-preview status, and committed to remediation before GA. **Patch status at March 24, 2026 GA is not confirmed in the Register coverage.**

## API rate cards and subscription-to-API mapping (added 2026-04-26 update)

**[41]** "Pricing." *Anthropic Claude API Docs*, accessed 2026-04-26.
<https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing>
**Tier:** 2
Per-million-token rate card for all Claude models. Opus 4.7/4.6/4.5: $5 base input, $25 output, $0.50 cache read (10% of input), $6.25 5m cache write (1.25x input), $10 1h cache write (2x input). Sonnet 4.6/4.5: $3 / $15 / $0.30 / $3.75 / $6. Haiku 4.5: $1 / $5 / $0.10 / $1.25 / $2. Batch API: 50% off all rates. 1M-token context at standard pricing for Opus 4.7/4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 (no surcharge). Opus 4.7 uses a new tokenizer that "may use up to 35% more tokens for the same fixed text" vs prior models. Opus 4.6 Fast Mode (research preview): 6x rates ($30 input, $150 output). Web search tool: $10 per 1,000 searches. Code execution: 1,550 free hours/month/org, then $0.05/hour/container. Data residency (US-only): 1.1x multiplier on all token categories.

**[42]** "Prompt caching." *Anthropic Claude API Docs*, accessed 2026-04-26.
<https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching>
**Tier:** 2
Cache pricing multipliers stack with the Batch API discount and data residency. 5-minute cache write = 1.25x base input price. 1-hour cache write = 2x base input price. Cache read (hit) = 0.1x base input price. "A cache hit costs 10% of the standard input price, which means caching pays off after just one cache read for the 5-minute duration (1.25x write), or after two cache reads for the 1-hour duration (2x write)."

**[43]** "Using Claude Code with your Pro or Max plan." *Anthropic Help Center*, accessed 2026-04-26.
<https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11145838-using-claude-code-with-your-pro-or-max-plan>
**Tier:** 2
Pro and Max plan usage limits are shared across Claude (web/desktop/mobile) and Claude Code, "meaning all activity in both tools counts against the same usage limits." When limits hit, options for Pro: upgrade to Max 5x, enable extra usage, switch to pay-as-you-go API, or wait for reset. For Max: upgrade to Max 20x, enable extra usage, switch to pay-as-you-go API, or wait. "All transitions to API credit usage require explicit user consent." Anthropic does NOT publish absolute token, message, or hour caps for any plan in this article.

**[44]** "What is the Max plan?" *Anthropic Help Center*, accessed 2026-04-26.
<https://support.claude.com/en/collections/12394590-max-plan>
**Tier:** 2
Max 5x ($100/mo) provides "5 times more usage per session than the Pro plan." Max 20x ($200/mo) provides "20x more usage per session." Both Max tiers operate two weekly limits in parallel: one cross-model and one Sonnet-specific, both reset 7 days from session start. Anthropic reserves the right to "limit your usage in other ways, such as weekly and monthly caps or model and feature usage, at our discretion." Specific numerical limits are NOT provided in this article.

**[45]** "Manage extra usage for paid Claude plans." *Anthropic Help Center*, accessed 2026-04-26.
